skill.name: ui-design
skill.description: Design real UI screens before building them, then build them in the user's code. Use when someone asks to design, redesign or improve the look of a page, screen, landing page, dashboard, app or component, wants a frontend that does not look generic, or wants to see and edit the design before code is written. Designs on a UX Pilot canvas the user can open and edit, then implements the chosen screens in the project's own stack. Needs the UX Pilot MCP server (free plan available).
skill.summary: Preview and refine screens in UX Pilot, then build them with your project's components and design tokens.
skill.author: uxpilot-ai

security_audit.summary: The flagged text documents Markdown examples, user-led MCP setup, and design features, rather than command substitution or reconnaissance. The workflow sends briefs to UX Pilot before run approval and tells the assistant to relay upgrade links without verification. No evidence of malicious intent or an attempt to override the audit was found.

remediation.issue: The first design call can send project-derived data before the user approves a run.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact brief or import payload and name the recipient before the first external call. Remove secrets and private data, and obtain approval before sending.

remediation.issue: Upgrade links from tool responses are relayed without a destination check.
remediation.suggestion: Summarize the limit in your own words and direct users to billing through the official account interface. Do not relay unverified payment or sign-in links.

content.user_title: Design and Build UI Screens with UX Pilot
content.value_statement: Reviewing layouts after implementation can lead to rework. Preview and edit screens in UX Pilot, then build the selected designs with your project's components and styles.
actual_capabilities: Turn product goals, target users, screen requirements, and brand styles into a design brief.
Request mobile or desktop designs from UX Pilot and share an editable canvas link.
Import assistant-written HTML and apply targeted edits to the canvas.
Review reported contrast, text clipping, and touch target issues.
Rebuild selected screens in the existing stack with project components and design tokens.
Compare an implementation screenshot with the design preview when browser tools are available.
limitations: Requires a connected UX Pilot MCP server and a signed-in account for canvas work.
UX Pilot generation uses credits, and free accounts have a weekly limit on imports and edits.
Free accounts cannot read the HTML of UX Pilot-generated screens. A rebuild from the preview may differ.
React export for a new project requires a paid plan.

use_cases.title: Review a Mobile Screen Concept
use_cases.description: Compare layouts on an editable canvas before choosing a design for implementation.

use_cases.title: Implement a Dashboard Redesign
use_cases.description: Rebuild selected screens with existing components, design tokens, and responsive behavior.

use_cases.title: Test a Product Onboarding Layout
use_cases.description: Review signup and welcome screens with sample content before committing to development.

prompt_templates.title: Preview One Screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review a single mobile layout.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a mobile appointment screen using sample content. Show me the editable canvas link and wait before writing application code.

prompt_templates.title: Import a Custom Mockup
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Review a custom desktop layout on the canvas.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a desktop settings screen in HTML with sample data. Show me what you will send and wait for approval before importing it into UX Pilot.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Connected Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Give feedback on screens that belong to one flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan signup, profile setup, and completion screens using our public brand guide. Let me review the brief before sending it. Share the canvas and flag design check issues.

prompt_templates.title: Implement an Approved Redesign
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Build selected screens inside an existing app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the approved dashboard screens using our existing components and design tokens. Include loading, empty, and error states. Compare desktop and mobile screenshots against the canvas.

output_examples.input: Show me a desktop account settings design before implementation.
output_examples.output: The editable canvas shows account details, notification preferences, and save controls. No application files were changed.

output_examples.input: Build the approved dashboard screen in the existing app.
output: The dashboard uses the existing table, buttons, and spacing tokens.
Filters and empty states are wired into the existing data flow.
The desktop layout matches the preview. Filters stack on narrower screens.

best_practices: Specify the target users, screen size, and the main task for each screen.
Use public or sample content and review what will be sent to UX Pilot before sharing it.
Review the canvas before implementation and reuse existing project components where possible.
anti_patterns: Include customer records or credentials in a brief or HTML import.
Paste exported HTML into the app without adapting it to the existing framework.
Treat automated design checks as proof that the implemented app is accessible.

faq.question: What do I need to use the skill?
faq.answer: Use an MCP-capable client, connect the UX Pilot server, and sign in to your UX Pilot account.

faq.question: Can I use a free account?
faq.answer: Yes. You can import your own HTML and edit it within the weekly action limit. Generated designs use credits.

faq.question: Can I review the design before coding starts?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow shares the editable canvas first. Ask for design only to keep application files unchanged.

faq.question: What data is sent to UX Pilot?
faq.answer: The connector receives design briefs, HTML imports, and requests to edit screens. Review those inputs and remove sensitive information before sharing.

faq.question: What happens if the generated HTML is unavailable?
faq.answer: You can choose a rebuild from the design preview. The result may differ from the original.

faq.question: Do I need to use React?
faq.answer: No. The skill can rebuild designs in your existing stack. Direct React export for a new project is a separate paid feature.
